join_option_vocabulary.item_field: from_field is an array of objects; the match reads this key of each element
join_option_vocabulary.skip_values: from_field values equal to one of these are not joined

match_vocabulary.body_citation: the record body cites the target's to_field value, found by `pattern`; a hit absent from the target id set is dropped
match_vocabulary.body_link: the record body holds a markdown link, found by `pattern` group 1, to the target's repo-relative path; the link resolves against the linking file and a miss is dropped
match_vocabulary.equals: from_field value equals to_field value of the target record
match_vocabulary.in_list: an element of the from_field array equals to_field value of the target record
match_vocabulary.path: from_field holds the repo-relative path of the target record
